S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has held at 1040 since Jul 2 (drifted up from 1030 on Jul 1) while the future round-tripped 1047 to 1065.5 back to 1057.7, oscillating around the pain point without extending far from it. The 1080 call wall has grown every session (1534 to 1682 to 1884 to 1700 to 1834 OI) and carries the week's largest single-strike volume today (357), confirming it as a live near-term resistance under the Vol2Vol filter. The 910 put wall, by contrast, swelled from 2171 to 3210 OI on minimal volume (64 today) - a stale structural tail hedge, not an active support level. ATM IV compressed roughly 10% relative (15.33% to 13.79%) over the past 4 sessions even as the future round-tripped 18 points, while both call and put OI grew every day this week (calls +40%, puts +50% since Jul 1), marking this DTE-83 series as still in its OI-building phase. Cumulative net GEX only turns positive above roughly 1085-1090, driven by the deep-tail put protection rather than a live near-money pin, so the 1040 max-pain level should be read as a loose center of gravity, not a magnet.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040P/1000P
strategies.rationale: Neutral-gamma Protection zone with IV at the week's low (13.79%) makes downside insurance cheap while both call and put OI are still building 83 days from expiry.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, approximately 11.4 points per spread (1040 put premium 22.6 minus 1000 put premium 11.2).
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above the 1080 call wall would extend the range higher and reduce the near-term need for this hedge.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1000P/1030P x 1080C/1100C
strategies.rationale: The 1080 call wall (OI 1834, today's largest volume at 357) and building 1030 put OI (723) mark live near-money boundaries; a small tactical range trade fits while IV compresses, sized small since the broader regime is still Protection/OI-building rather than a confirmed long-gamma pin.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = wing width (30) minus net credit (approximately 15.6) = approximately 14.4 points per side.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1030 or 1080 breaks the range and should trigger an exit ahead of wing expiry.

S50U26.prediction: Base case: S50U26 continues to range between the 1040 max-pain/support zone and the 1080 call wall over the next several sessions, with pullbacks toward 1030-1040 likely to find OI-backed support (723 and 617 contracts at those strikes). A sustained close above 1080 - where call OI (1834) and today's volume (357) concentrate - would confirm a live break through resistance and shift the read toward a short-gamma squeeze, since the cumulative flip sits just above it (approximately 1085-1090); a break below 990-1000, where OI thins sharply to under 300 per strike, would instead test whether the deep 910 protection band is real support or just static insurance. Invalidation of the range-bound base case: a daily close beyond 1080 or below 990.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only, not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind any pin or max-pain magnet are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks - treat 1040 as a loose center of gravity, not a guaranteed target, and size any structure defined-risk only.
